slices.company: company-data single-doc and company-data multi-doc categories
slices.general: All other registered categories, including GPQA/reasoning, knowledge, instruction-following, privacy and safety-boundary

roleAllocation: Seeded item randomization within each slice; floor fit/select/calib, audit gets the remainder. Source groups may overlap roles and are explicitly disclosed.
riskMethod: One candidate threshold per model/slice selected using SELECT only, then exact hypergeometric finite-population upper-risk bound from CALIB; familywise alpha/6. Failed certification abstains without trying another threshold.
certificateScope: Accepted CALIB+AUDIT items in the fixed dev frame, conditional on frozen FIT/SELECT policy. Not final test, future queries, unseen source families or the full FIT/SELECT population.
unknownLabelRiskPolicy: Unknown or unsupported labels count as wrong for threshold selection and certification; reporting retains unknown-label counts separately.
acceptanceGates: Safe manifest; answer/self-check parse and usage known; no answer or self-check cap hit; valid retrieved IDs and complete company claim citations; runtime source completeness 1.0 and unchanged best-match threshold 0.35; self-check support/completeness/issues pass. General questions have no company-source requirement.
testPolicy: No test answers, references, rows or contexts enter fitting, selection or certification. User-approved saved Stage 2 replay is opened only after all thresholds and certificates are durably locked; descriptive results cannot retune policy.
cloudCostPolicy: Offline native/proxy token counts of lean redacted per-item payloads; all-query cloud fees and matched cloud-only baseline; output lengths/prices are assumptions; no actual calls or spend.
cloudBudgetPolicy: CLOUD_BUDGET_USD remains unset; external generation, grading and token counting are prohibited.
stopAfter: Stage 3. Do not begin Stage 4 slice-based reporting or any paid tier.
